# Imagine it Done

> > Professional home organization services in NYC led by Lisa Jacobs, offering decluttering, space design, and curated product recommendations across all room types.

Imagine it Done is a New York-based home organization company specializing in custom organizing solutions, decluttering services, and product curation. The site features the expertise of founder Lisa Jacobs and her team, along with a comprehensive portfolio of before-and-after projects and practical organization guides.

## Key Topics

- Home Organization
- Professional Organizers

- Affiliate Recommendations

## Room-Specific Organization

- [Master Closet Organization](https://www.imagineitdoneny.com/closet-organization): Master closet organization products including hangers and storage solutions
- [Kitchen Organization](https://www.imagineitdoneny.com/kitchen-and-pantry-organization): Kitchen and pantry storage products and organization solutions
- [Bathroom Storage Products](https://www.imagineitdoneny.com/bathroom-products): Bathroom storage products including Yamazaki organizers and drawer solutions
- [Nursery Essentials](https://www.imagineitdoneny.com/nursery-and-kids-organization): Nursery and kids room organizational products from OXO and IKEA
- [Work from Home Office Organization](https://www.imagineitdoneny.com/work-from-home-office): Work from home office organizational products and storage solutions
- [Laundry Room Organization](https://www.imagineitdoneny.com/laundry-and-utility-room): Laundry and utility room organization products and storage solutions
